I added `FFF_RETIRED_SETTINGS` in settings.ts and appended its leaves to `REVERTABLE` in pi-settings.ts. On a later setup the key is removed only if the record names it and it still equals false. A value the user set themselves, or changed since, stays. I did not add a record-less cleanup, which could delete a user's own value.
